en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Al Husayn altogether, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> – similar to it’.
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his men, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘A divorce of the child is (not) allowed when he is ten years old’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of his people who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that divorce by a child is [not] permissible when he becomes ten years old.”
